output.brief: The rise in ratequote's 5xx rate for the week of 26 Oct (0.41%, up from 0.31%) looks like ordinary week-to-week variation. Over the previous 26 weeks the normal upper limit is 0.48%, and this week sits below it. The error budget burn is 0.82x against a 2x paging line, and booking completion barely moved (41.0% to 41.2%). The release comparison is weak: new pods starting during a rollout can look worse for reasons unrelated to the code, and the 28 Oct replica move and the 29–30 Oct partner-sync run were not ruled out. I am fairly confident this does not need a rollback or an incident. Recommended: make no corrective change, record the week at ops review, and check the following week against the normal band. Do not mute the burn-rate page. If the next week rises above the band, investigate v4.18 and the replica move separately, starting with per-pod data for the last rollouts. I did not check the partner-sync timing or the rollout history.
